image_description: A bright green common iguana perched horizontally on a network of brown tree branches. The iguana has a prominent dorsal crest running down its back, a large dewlap under its chin, and distinct black banding on its tail. Its skin appears textured with scales, and it is gripping the branches with its limbs.
